info.title: ELIAS 18 API
info.description: For all routes except for the eLux routes, *api* needs to be included in the path.

tags.name: General Routes
tags.description: General routes are available for all containers.

tags.name: Authentication Routes
tags.description: Authentication routes are used for authentication and access control.

tags.name: Container Routes
tags.description: Container routes are operations on containers.

tags.name: Certificate Routes
tags.description: Certificate routes are all routes for signing and certificates for all containers.

tags.name: Solution Routes
tags.description: Solution routes help solve image definitions and find conflicts.

tags.name: eLux Routes
tags.description: eLux routes allow eLux clients to request files. However, if the route is called from a browser, the UI is shown.
